# Third-party notices

The generated `libmbed.a` contains Mbed OS and ArduinoCore-mbed components.
Mbed OS is distributed under Apache-2.0 with component-level exceptions and
notices retained in the pinned source tree. ArduinoCore-mbed is distributed
under LGPL-2.1 and component-level licenses.

Authoritative sources and complete license files:

- Mbed OS commit `17dc3dc2e6e2817a8bd3df62f38583319f0e4fed`
- ArduinoCore-mbed commit `6816d442fd00bc17f83c73396d3d8d90285a6a8a`

The build script requires those exact source trees and records their commits
and the final binary hashes in `artifact-manifest.json`.
